title: Travel: John Lennon – Tokyo to Johannesburg | 1978
content:
John Lennon, Yoko Ono, and Sean Lennon flew from Tokyo to Johannesburg on 16 September 1978.

They had been in Japan since 5 June, and remained in South Africa for several days before returning to New York on 21 September.
